verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the card creation API supports physical cards with shipping_address and product_id parameters, implying some card art/product selection and shipping capability, but there is no evidence of bulk ordering, shipping method selection, tracking, or details on card manufacturer abstraction. missing for 10: bulk order endpoints, shipping method options, tracking/status evidence, custom card art upload/design process, confirmation that Lithic fully manages manufacturer relationship without ops involvement.
